profile.algorithm: DirectBound: after original LP and original dual/helper all rejected, reuse the finite same-original-program LP candidate; if absent/invalid only, fresh original LP. Public RecoverPrimal entry starts a fresh original LP. Positive work normalization and original q8 primal/physical audit; if rejected, cap-QP(alpha .01, cap .999998), normalize and audit; if rejected, use that normalized candidate as the next center at exactly the same Fs and perform one final QP. Accepted original dual/helper always takes priority and skips this recipe.
profile.budgets: Direct original LP <=30s + separately scheduled dual <=30s + at most two QPs <=90s each; fresh LP <=30s only if original center absent/invalid. Up to270s solver caps with all fallback solves in this explicit profile, not a total case guarantee. Existing HSD fallback and external total-run deadline remain separate.
profile.proof: Only unchanged original PrimalAudit plus FieldGate plus finite value<=.999999 returns a candidate. All returned modified duals erased. No root is created; existing caller must close the original signed bracket.
